title.zh: Lovable AI 应用构建工具

content.en: Build and review web applications with shared usage credits, generated source and managed backend services. Compare prototype speed with security, operating cost and maintenance responsibility.
content.zh: 通过共享用量 credits、生成源码及托管后端构建并复核 Web 应用；比较原型速度、安全、运行成本与维护责任。

detail.en:
Choose Lovable for a small, testable web application with a named maintainer. Use a prototype to discover requirements; require engineering review before external users, payments or sensitive records. Compare the cost of a complete workflow, including corrections and operations, with a developer-owned implementation.

Plans checked September 14, 2026: Free is available. The official subscription table lists the 100-credit Pro tier at $25 monthly or $250 yearly, and Business at $50 monthly or $500 yearly. Annual totals are upfront commitments, not monthly payment offers. Larger credit tiers and Enterprise terms differ. Pro supports code editing and custom domains; Business adds governance such as SSO, with Enterprise-only controls requiring a separate check. Verify the checkout, region and tax before purchase. [Official plan table](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/subscription-plans).

Building, managed Cloud and AI inside deployed apps consume one workspace credit system. Grants apply to specific usage before general credits. Free currently grants 5 build credits daily up to 30 monthly, plus 20 monthly Cloud credits and 4 monthly app-AI credits. The pricing FAQ and detailed tables differ in how paid AI grants and regional daily caps are described; this page does not promise a universal paid grant. Plan mode has a 1-credit base message charge plus any subagent research, while building varies with work. Inspect actual usage instead of treating one prompt as one fixed-price result. [Usage mechanics](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/credits-and-usage) · [Pricing FAQ](https://lovable.dev/pricing).

The June billing announcement documents migration from separate balances. Current usage documentation still warns that some accounts may display the older view; no specific account migration was inspected here. Confirm converted credit history and auto-top-up settings in that workspace. Member limits apply to build usage only, so they do not cap project Cloud or AI spending. Monthly credits expire two months after issue; annual-plan credits expire one month after the annual period, and top-ups after twelve months. Cancellation freezes remaining paid credits after the billing period without extending expiry; refunds are subject to the terms and applicable law. [Migration](https://lovable.dev/blog/simplifying-billing) · [Admin controls](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/workspace-admin-settings) · [Terms](https://lovable.dev/terms).

Basic and Deep scans assist security review; a publish action can still allow unresolved critical findings unless stronger controls are enforced. For a connected Supabase backend, review per-table RLS, storage permissions and server endpoints. Test anonymous access and two different users against read and write operations, keep service secrets server-side, and review payment authorization separately. A passing scan or successful preview is not production certification. [Security](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/security) · [Supabase](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/supabase).

Ownership of generated code and output remains subject to third-party rights. Git sync does not move every database, file, credential, domain or managed service. Before launch, rehearse backup and restore, an export path and rollback; assign monitoring and dependency maintenance. Trial one non-sensitive workflow and record build credits, running usage, repair time and authorization failures. This is an editorial trial proposal, not a hands-on result.

Independent evidence: [Hands-on review (TechRadar)](https://www.techradar.com/pro/software-services/lovable-review) · [Adoption reporting (TechCrunch; vendor self-report)](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/09/lovable-says-it-has-hit-500m-in-annualized-revenue-with-1-million-new-projects-a-week/)

Official evidence: [Plans](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/subscription-plans) · [Credits and usage](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/credits-and-usage) · [Pricing](https://lovable.dev/pricing) · [Workspace administration](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/workspace-admin-settings) · [Security](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/security) · [Supabase integration](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/supabase) · [Billing migration](https://lovable.dev/blog/simplifying-billing) · [Terms](https://lovable.dev/terms) · [Brand resources](https://lovable.dev/brand)

Media: official brand artwork for identification, not a product screenshot or a trial result. [Source](https://lovablebrand.lovable.app/brand/logo).

detail.zh:
Lovable 适合范围明确、可验证且有维护责任人的小型 Web 应用。先用原型发现需求，在接入外部用户、支付或敏感记录前安排工程复核。应把修正与运营都计入完整工作流成本，再与开发者维护的实现比较。

2026-09-14 套餐核验：提供 Free。官方订阅表中，100 credits 档 Pro 为月付 25 美元或年付 250 美元；Business 为月付 50 美元或年付 500 美元。年费总额是预先承诺，不是每月扣款报价。更多额度档及 Enterprise 合同另计。Pro 支持代码编辑与自定义域名；Business 增加 SSO 等治理能力，Enterprise 专属控制需另行确认。购买前核对结账、地区及税费。[官方套餐表](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/subscription-plans)。

构建、托管 Cloud 与已部署应用中的 AI 使用统一工作区 credits 体系。专用赠送额度先于通用额度消耗。Free 当前每天赠送 5 个构建 credits、每月最多 30，另有每月 20 个 Cloud credits 与 4 个应用 AI credits。价格 FAQ 与详细表对付费 AI 赠送及地区每日额度上限的说明不完全相同，本页不承诺所有付费账户都有同一赠送额度。Plan mode 每条基础费用为 1 credit，子代理研究另计；构建按实际工作变化。应检查真实用量，不能将一次提示视为固定价格成品。[用量规则](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/credits-and-usage) · [价格 FAQ](https://lovable.dev/pricing)。

6 月计费公告记录了从双余额迁移的过程；当前用量文档仍提醒部分账户可能看到旧界面，本次没有检查任何特定账户的迁移完成情况。需在实际工作区核对转换记录与自动充值设置。成员限额只约束构建，不封顶项目 Cloud 或 AI 运行费。月付 credits 发放两个月后到期；年付额度在年度结束一个月后到期，充值额度十二个月后到期。取消后，剩余付费 credits 在当前计费期结束后冻结，且不会延长有效期；退款依条款及适用法律处理。[迁移公告](https://lovable.dev/blog/simplifying-billing) · [管理控制](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/workspace-admin-settings) · [条款](https://lovable.dev/terms)。

Basic 与 Deep 扫描辅助安全复核；如果没有强制更严格的控制，仍可能带着未解决的严重问题发布。连接 Supabase 时要逐表核对 RLS、存储权限及服务端接口。分别用匿名用户及两个不同账户测试读写隔离，服务密钥只放服务端，支付授权另行检查。扫描通过或预览正常均不等于生产安全认证。[安全文档](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/security) · [Supabase](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/supabase)。

生成代码与输出的归属仍受第三方权利约束。Git 同步不会搬走所有数据库、文件、凭证、域名或托管服务。上线前演练备份恢复、导出与回滚，并指定监控及依赖维护人员。先以非敏感流程试用，记录构建额度、运行用量、修复时间及授权失败。这是编辑建议的试用方案，并非本站实测结论。

独立证据：[Hands-on review (TechRadar)](https://www.techradar.com/pro/software-services/lovable-review) · [Adoption reporting (TechCrunch; vendor self-report)](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/09/lovable-says-it-has-hit-500m-in-annualized-revenue-with-1-million-new-projects-a-week/)

官方证据：[Plans](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/subscription-plans) · [Credits and usage](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/credits-and-usage) · [Pricing](https://lovable.dev/pricing) · [Workspace administration](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/workspace-admin-settings) · [Security](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/security) · [Supabase integration](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/supabase) · [Billing migration](https://lovable.dev/blog/simplifying-billing) · [Terms](https://lovable.dev/terms) · [Brand resources](https://lovable.dev/brand)

en: A working preview does not validate authorization, RLS or payment logic.
Build, Cloud and app AI share credits; member limits only cap building.
Planning research can add usage beyond the base Plan mode message charge.
Credit expiry and cancellation can restrict access to unused paid credits.
Built-in scans do not certify application security.
Code ownership does not migrate data, secrets, domains or managed services.
Grant eligibility and regional terms must be checked in the actual workspace.
zh: 预览可用不能证明授权、RLS 或支付逻辑正确。
构建、Cloud 和应用 AI 共用 credits；成员限额只管构建。
Plan mode 研究可在基础消息费用之外增加消耗。
credits 到期及取消订阅会限制剩余付费额度的使用。
内置扫描不能认证应用安全。
代码归属不等于数据、密钥、域名及托管服务已迁移。
赠送额度及地区条件应以实际工作区核验为准。
